usedFor: Todoist holds tasks and Google Blogger holds posts, so “New Task Created in Project” can run “Create Blog Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Blog Post” in Google Blogger
bestTemplate.why: A task in your content project starts a blog post, so ideas stop sitting in a list.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so “Create Blog Post” runs after a scheduled check.
